description_en: Submits resource evaluation results to Cloud Config through Function Compute
description_zh: 函数计算通过PutEvaluations接口将资源评估结果返回给配置审计
name: PutEvaluations

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion mode. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled. This is the default value.

This parameter takes effect only when you manually or periodically trigger the evaluation of resources by using a custom function rule. If deletion mode is enabled, evaluation results that are not updated during the current evaluation period are automatically deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用删除模式。取值：

true：启用。
false（默认值）：不启用。

仅当您手动触发或周期触发自定义函数规则评估资源时，该参数有效。如果启用删除模式，会自动删除本次评估期间未更新的评估结果
parameters.name: delete_mode

parameters.help_en:
The callback token. You must first activate Function Compute and create a function, and then call CreateConfigRule with SourceOwner set to CUSTOM_FC to create a custom rule that points to the function. After the rule evaluation is triggered, extract the resultToken from the event input parameter of the function, and call PutEvaluations to submit the evaluation results within the execution window of the current function.

You can obtain the `ResultToken` from the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/127405.html. For more information about how to obtain function input parameters from Function Compute, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73349.html
parameters.help_zh:
回调令牌。先开通函数计算并创建函数，再通过 CreateConfigRule（SourceOwner=CUSTOM_FC）创建指向该函数的自定义规则；触发规则评估后，从函数 event 入参中提取 resultToken，并在本次函数执行窗口内调用 PutEvaluations 提交评估结果。

`ResultToken`从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/127405.html中获取。关于如何从函数计算中获取函数入参，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73349.html
parameters.name: result_token

Result.description_en:
The submit status of the evaluation results for the custom function rule. Valid values:

true: Success.

fasle: Failure
Result.description_zh:
自定义函数规则评估结果的提交状态。取值：

true：成功。

fasle：失败
